name: Spotify Radio Station TV
description: Enhances Spotify radio/genre station pages with bigger cards and focus states for TV

params.css: [data-testid='genre-page'] [data-testid='card'], [class*='genre'] [class*='Card'] { min-width: 200px !important; min-height: 160px !important; border-radius: 12px !important; } [data-testid='genre-page'] [data-testid='card']:hover, [data-testid='genre-page'] [data-testid='card']:focus-within { transform: scale(1.05) !important; outline: 3px solid #1db954 !important; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(29,185,84,0.3) !important; } [data-testid='genre-page'] h2 { font-size: 28px !important; } [data-testid='genre-page'] [data-testid='card'] span { font-size: 16px !important; }
